A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GM-MoE research. All 17 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables, appendices A.1–A.4 and references, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-enhancement scores, component ablations and qualitative results in Section 4 and Appendix A.1.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark scores, ablations and qualitative enhancement results, including the appendix comparisons.

M1.justification: The U-Net-like architecture, three expert networks, dynamic gating, SFEB and PSNR loss are unchanged. Removing the parenthetical WA abbreviation in Section 4.3 does not alter the gating procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate LOL-v1, LOLv2-Real, LOLv2-Synthetic, LSRW-Huawei and LSRW-Nikon. The object-detection example in Figure 7 and appendix scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1, 2 and 4 and the qualitative comparisons. Appendix comparators 3DLUT, Sparse, RUAS and DRBN were already present in v1.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same dataset splits, 256 × 256 input resizing, augmentation, batch size of 4, two million training iterations and PSNR/SSIM evaluation. The ablation configurations are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 3 and Figure 8 retain the same eight ablation configurations examining SFEB, the experts and dynamic gating. The qualitative case analyses in Section 4.2 and Appendix A.1 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report single benchmark scores without repeated-run counts, seeds, uncertainty intervals or statistical tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–4 and qualitative outputs are unchanged. For example, GM-MoE retains 26.66/0.857 PSNR/SSIM on LOL-v1 and 23.55/0.741 on LSRW-Huawei. Changed table cross-references do not change results.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 retain the same gating, expert aggregation, interpolation, feature weighting and loss definitions. Neither version adds or revises formal assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty, dynamic adaptation, generalization and benchmark-performance claims. The stated contributions are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning expert complementarity, detail recovery and generalization remain unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains the same discussion of computational complexity, downstream applicability and alternative losses.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures retain the same PyTorch framework, NVIDIA 4090, three-day training time, optimizer and hyperparameters. Appendix A.3 still promises code release after acceptance without providing a repository link.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning and all 68 bibliography entries are unchanged. Revised figure and table references are internal navigation edits, not changes to cited research.

P1.justification: v3 adds Kurban Ubul as a corresponding author, abbreviates several Figure references to Fig., explicitly labels the Figure 10 reference, changes two Section 4.2 references from Table 4 to Table 2 and removes the parenthetical WA abbreviation. Section organization and substantive prose remain stable.

P2.justification: The first-page author block changes from five to six authors, repositioning the second row, and several paragraphs reflow slightly. All eleven figures and four tables retain their content, captions, structure and placement.

improvement.justification: Section 4.2 now directs the Huawei/Nikon comparison to Table 2, which contains the discussed Restormer and GM-MoE scores, instead of appendix Table 4. The explicit Figure 10 reference also improves navigation. These corrections provide a small improvement in traceability; the scientific evidence and its limitations remain unchanged.
